name: designer-picks-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for `designerPicks` (simple tier — the curated 'Designer picks' one-tap swatch row above the full floor/wall finish grid in FinishPicker). Opens the FinishPicker for livingDining, asserts the `[role=group][aria-label='Designer picks']` row renders on the Floor tab with >0 curated swatches, clicks the 2nd curated swatch and asserts `finishes.floor['livingDining']` becomes one of the known curated floor ids, switches to the Walls tab and asserts a SEPARATE curated row renders there too, then re-verifies both rows are present after a Simple→Pro switch (designerPicks is simple-tier, shown in both modes) and absent when the flag is explicitly overridden off.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: verify-designerpicks-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: designerPicks should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: finish-picker-visible
steps.failMessage: FinishPicker (.panel.inspector) did not appear after room selection

steps.name: designer-picks-row-visible-floor
steps.eval: (function(){ const grp = document.querySelector("[role='group'][aria-label='Designer picks']"); if (!grp) throw new Error('Designer picks row did not render on the Floor tab'); const n = grp.querySelectorAll('button').length; if (n === 0) throw new Error('Designer picks row rendered with 0 swatches'); window.__floorPicksCount = n; })()

steps.name: click-second-designer-pick
steps.eval: (function(){ const grp = document.querySelector("[role='group'][aria-label='Designer picks']"); const btns = [...grp.querySelectorAll('button')]; const btn = btns[1] || btns[0]; if (!btn) throw new Error('No designer-pick swatch to click'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: floor-finish-applied
steps.failMessage: finishes.floor['livingDining'] should be one of the known curated floor ids after clicking a Designer pick swatch

steps.name: switch-to-walls-tab
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Walls'); if (!btn) throw new Error("'Walls' tab button not found"); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: designer-picks-row-visible-walls
steps.failMessage: Designer picks row did not render on the Walls tab

steps.name: verify-designerpicks-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: designerPicks should still be ON in Pro mode (simple-tier flags are shown in both modes)

steps.name: designer-picks-still-present-in-pro
steps.failMessage: Designer picks row should still render in Pro mode

steps.name: designer-picks-hidden-when-forced-off
steps.eval: (function(){ const grp = document.querySelector("[role='group'][aria-label='Designer picks']"); if (grp) throw new Error('Designer picks row should be hidden when the flag is forced off'); })()
